sentences.text: Date : 30/03/2026 (Michael Zothankhuma, J) This is a jail appeal against the impugned judgement dated 20/08/2025 passed by the learned Special Judge, POCSO, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur, in Special (POCSO) case No. 97/2024, by which the appellant has been convicted under section 324 IPC and section 6/18 of the POCSO Act.

sentences.text: Mr. R.R. Kaushik, learned APP, Assam, appears for the State.

Notice be issued to the informant Smt. Janmoni Phukan, wife of Babu Phukan, through the Officer-in-Charge, North Lakhimpur Police Station, inasmuch as, the case pertains to North Lakhimpur PS case No. 130/2024 under section 376(2)(f) IPC read with section 6 of the POCSO Act.

A soft copy of the appeal be furnished by the Registry to the learned APP's Office, who shall thereafter forward the same to the Officer-in-Charge of the concerned Police Station, for giving the same to the informant.
Mr. Arnab Das, learned counsel is appointed as Amicus Curiae to represent the appellant in this case.
